collections.description:
ADVANTAGE COLLECTION

Thickness: 3mm        Top Layer: 20mil      Width: 6"        Length: 48"

Classic faux wood designs reflecting a diverse range of wood species, finished with contemporary colors. The wide plank width and thicker wear layer provide a look and finish that is appropriate for both commercial and residential installations.

collections.title: All GemCore Tiles
collections.description: The complexity of installing large format stone tile has made this popular look impractical in all but a few projects. GemCore eliminates these barriers, offering this sought after look in an easy to install, simple to maintain design that offers a gorgeous finished appearance designed to withstand heavy use. The sophisticated stone composite structure allows for a thinner (lighter) tile that combined with a user-friendly “click together” system can be installed without specialized equipment, requires far less prep and can be accomplished in a fraction of the time. Added benefits include greater comfort for walking and a varied look without the off-color or off-pattern tiles inherent in natural stone. For a more in-depth comparison click here

collections.title: Avalon
collections.description:
AVALON COLLECTION


 

Thickness: 3/8"        Top Layer: 1.5mm      Width: 7-1/2"        Length: Random Length (16" - 82", 50% full)

Authentic wood at a “plastic” wood price. What do we mean by that? Reward’s Avalon collection is genuine wide plank hardwood flooring at a price that competes with the plastic ‘wood look’ Rigid Composite floors that have flooded the market in recent years. Real wood flooring increases the value of your home, and Avalon lets you to do that at an exceptional value. Each authentic wood plank is unique and tells its own story, avoiding the repeating patterns and “plastic feel” of Rigid Composite floors that scream “artificial.” See and feel the rustic charm and natural variation of real Avalon wood floors for yourself.

collections.title: Camino II
collections.description:
CAMINO II COLLECTION

Thickness: 1/2"        Top Layer: 2mm      Width: 5"        Length: Random Length 16" - 71" (20% full)

Reward Flooring's Camino II Collection offers a compilation of today's most popular American species in a wide color palette ranging from light brown to deep charcoal. Subtle hand-scraping and natural time-worn distressing give your home a casual, comfortable appeal.

collections.title: Canyons
collections.description:
CANYONS COLLECTION

Thickness: 1/2"        Top Layer: 2mm      Width: 5"        Length: Random Length 16" - 75" (8% full)

The Canyons Collection features classic colors in a smooth, ultra-matte finish, with lengths that exceed most competitors in its class. Simple, elegant, timeless.

collections.title: Castillo
collections.description:
CASTILLO COLLECTION

Thickness: 3/8"        Top Layer: 1.2mm      Width: 6-1/2"        Length: Random Length 16" - 48" (67% full)

Uniquely beautiful, uniquely affordable. The Castillo Collection features Arborea, a plantation-grown wood with extraordinary grain structure that is subtle from afar but spectacular up close. With a surface that is scraped with hand tools by experienced craftsmen, the inevitable dings and dents that are a part of living on hardwood will blend naturally into this floor’s original rustic charm.

collections.title: Costa
collections.description:
COSTA COLLECTION

Thickness: 5/8"        Top Layer: 4mm      Width: 7-1/2"        Length: Random Length 23" - 75" (67% full)

Enjoy the breezy freshness of this coastal take on the rustic Old World elegance of wide-plank European Oak. The Costa Collection’s natural gray, taupe and caramel tones impart an airy, expansive feeling to virtually any décor. Gentle distressing and thick wear layers insure decades of care-free enjoyment.  Rustic Grade hardwood. Ultra-matte UV Urethane finish.

collections.title: Duracork
collections.description:
DURACORK COLLECTION

Thickness: 10mm        Top Layer: 4mm      Width: 5-1/2"        Length: 48"

Invite a little bit of nature into your home and enjoy the natural resiliency and warmth of this time-tested flooring tradition. Harvesting of Cork bark today is much the same as it has been for hundreds of years. The bark of the Cork Oak is harvested once every nine years without harming the tree, allowing it to live up to 200 years - making Cork one of nature's truly 100% eco-friendly resources. Experience all of the benefits that Cork offers in this designer's dream collection of cork floors!

collections.title: Earth 12" x 24" Tiles
collections.description:
EARTH COLLECTION

Thickness: 5mm       Wear Layer: 20 mil      Width: 12"        Length: 24"

The Earth collection is built with GemCore's industry leading stone composite technology, offering the distinctive looks of ceramic and natural stone in a much more user-friendly and budget-friendly format.  GemCore tiles are far easier to install and maintain than traditional tiles. Each plank has a unique stone embossed texture and  a large painted bevel that creates the look of a grout joint, but without the risk of cracking or discoloration like traditional grout. GemCore's unique construction broadens the desirable look of tile to a wider range of projects while still offering the stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance needed for challenging environments like bathrooms and kitchens. Learn more about GemCore tiles. Learn more about GemCore tiles

collections.title: Earth XL 18 "x 36" Tiles
collections.description:
EARTH XL COLLECTION

Thickness: 5mm        Wear Layer: 20 mil      Width: 18"        Length: 36"

The complexity and high cost of installing large format ceramic and stone tile has made this popular look impractical for many projects. GemCore Earth XL tiles eliminate these barriers, offering this sought-after look in a format that is easy to install and simple to maintain. Installing GemCore requires far less prep than traditional tile, and can be accomplished in a fraction of the time. A beautiful stone embossed texture lends a natural feel to a durable commercial-grade wear surface. A pronounced painted bevel mimics the look of a grout joint when the tiles are assembled together, but this grout joint won't stain or discolor! Added benefits include greater comfort for walking and a varied look without the off-color or off-pattern tiles inherent in natural stone. Learn more about GemCore tiles

collections.title: El Paso
collections.description:
EL PASO COLLECTION

Thickness: 3/8"        Top Layer: 1.2mm      Width: 5"        Length: Random Length 16" - 48" (50% full)

The El Paso Collection combines the durability of Hickory, our hardest North American commercial species, with timeless colors and a hand-scraped surface for maximum resistance to life’s little mishaps. An American classic, at an incredible value.

collections.title: Emerald
collections.description:
.   EMERALD COLLECTION

Thickness: 4mm        Wear Layer: 12 mil       Width: 7"        Length: 48.6"

The Emerald Collection offers the exceptional durability of GemCore construction in a cost effective design. Emerald Features fashionable colors in attractive wide planks with wood embossed texture and subtle "kissed" bevels.  Boasting superior stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance, Emerald planks include a lifetime residential warranty and a pre-attached EVA foam underlayment pad, for durability and comfort. Emerald is a sought after option for residential and light commercial applications, and a popular choice for homebuilders. Learn more about GemCore

collections.title: Engineered Hardwood
collections.description: Scroll through our exceptional domestic and exotic hardwood offerings. Each material selected for its natural beauty and performance in flooring, each offered in distinct factory finishes that ensures your floor provides you not only a beautiful appearance but also a premier level of durability.

collections.title: Europa
collections.description:
EUROPA COLLECTION

Thickness: 9/16"        Top Layer: 3.5mm      Width: 5-1/2"        Length: Random Length 23" - 86-5/8" (67% full)

Made in Europe with uncompromising quality, the Europa Collection offers classic Scandinavian styling. These floors feature consistently long planks in Prime Grade that is virtually free of knots, for an elegant, uniform look. The smooth European Oak floors (with one wire-brushed option) are offered in subtle, light colors that bring a clean, modern, vibrant look to any space, finished off with a durable ultra-matte urethane finish.

collections.title: Islands
collections.description:
ISLANDS COLLECTION

Thickness: 1/2"        Top Layer: 2mm      Width: 7-1/2"        Length: Random Length 23" - 82" (60% full)

An upgrade to Reward’s popular Shores Collection, the Islands Collection features wider and longer planks than the original classic. "Modern luxury" best describes this gorgeous range of colors achieved through our advanced smoking and staining technologies. These techniques result in a subtle, naturally aged appearance, with a wide range of colors to suit virtually any residential or commercial aesthetic.

collections.title: Jade
collections.description:
JADE COLLECTION

Thickness: 4mm          Wear Layer: 12 mil      Width: 5-5/8"        Length: 48"

The Jade Collection appeals to those looking to retain a classic look, with a more conventional width and a subtle, 'kissed' bevel edge. While the aesthetics of the collection are timeless, the structure of the Jade's GemCore construction is at the forefront of resilient flooring. GemCore's industry leading stone composite technology offers an array of advantages over other types of flooring, including superior stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance. A robust wear layer with a lifetime residential warranty offers enduring appeal. Learn more about GemCore

collections.title: Luxury Vinyl
collections.description: We offer beautiful, affordable wood designs without compromising quality though leveraging superior construction technologies. Browse our contemporary colors and rich textures, or filter for qualities that meet the specific requirements of your residential or commercial projects.

collections.title: Majesty
collections.description:
MAJESTY COLLECTION

Thickness: 3mm        Top Layer: 20mil       Width: 10"        Length: 60"

Classic faux wood designs reflecting a diverse range of wood species, finished with contemporary colors. The super wide 10" plank width and thicker wear layer provide a look and finish that was specifically developed for larger scale commercial use.

collections.title: Meridian
collections.description:
MERIDIAN COLLECTION

Thickness: 2mm        Top Layer: 12 mil      Width: 6"        Length: Random Length 48"

Classic faux wood designs reflecting a diverse range of wood species, finished with contemporary colors. The wide plank width and thicker wear layer provide a look and finish that is appropriate for both light commercial and residential installations.

collections.title: Mill Creek
collections.description:
MILL CREEK COLLECTION

 

Thickness: 5/8"        Top Layer: 4mm      Width: 7-1/2"        Length: Random Length 23" - 75" (70% full)

Textured with genuine bandsaw marks straight from the sawmill, and colored with all-natural aging effects, the Mill Creek Collection offers the authentic look and feel of a reclaimed wood floor. Topped with a durable ultra-matte UV urethane, Mill Creek floors speak of generations past and will last for generations to come. A great option for walls as well!

collections.title: Napa
collections.description:
NAPA COLLECTION

Thickness: 1/2"        Top Layer: 2mm       Width: 4-6-8"        Length: Random Length 20" - 94" (8% full)

This stunning collection evokes the days before modern machinery, when each board in a wood floor was cut by hand to a size suggested by nature, and then fitted with care into a floor intended to be walked on by generations within the same family. Boards of varying widths are authentically hand-scraped, telling the story of the craftsman who made them. The random widths form visual patterns that hold your interest, in a range of beautiful colors to suit any taste.

collections.title: Onyx
collections.description:
ONYX COLLECTION

Thickness: 5mm.      Wear Layer: 20 mil     Width: 9"        Length: 60"

Onyx offers the beautiful look and feel of wide plank hardwood flooring on a body that can survive the most challenging interior environments. Onyx features a super-wide 9" plank featuring Embossed In Register (EIR) texture, for an ultra-realistic wood experience that is further enhanced by a pronounced, painted bevel. The greater overall plank size is supported by a robust, commercially rated wear layer and our high-density XPE pre-attached pad.  GemCore boasts an array of advantages over other types of flooring, including superior stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance. Learn more about GemCore

collections.title: Provence III
collections.description:
PROVENCE III Collection

PLANK AND HERRINGBONE

Plank and Herringbone

Plank – Thickness: 1/2”  Top Layer: 2mm   Width: 7-1/2”    Length: Random Length (20” – 75”)

Herringbone - Thickness: 1/2”  Top Layer: 2mm   Width: 4-3/4”    Length: 24”

The latest update to our renowned Provence series, Provence III takes this line to new heights with a longer mix of plank lengths and gorgeous new colors that meet today’s demand for more neutral, natural hues. Stately 7.5" wide boards are well suited to today’s open floor plans, while the updated colors add inviting sophistication. New to the collection for 2026, is the herringbone option in all shades. Provence III offers quality, luxury, wide-plank flooring at a value unexpected for engineered hardwood flooring of this caliber.

collections.title: Ruby
collections.description:
RUBY COLLECTION

Thickness: 6.5mm        Wear Layer: 28 mil     Width: 7"        Length: 48"

The Ruby collection is built with GemCore's industry leading stone composite technology. GemCore boasts an array of advantages over other types of flooring, including superior stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance. The Ruby Collection features the heaviest wear layer within the GemCore collection, suitable for the most demanding commercial applications. Offered in a 7" wide plank, subtle "kissed" bevel edge, and wide range of wood colors, Ruby is a versatile option for residential and commercial floors alike. Learn more about GemCore

collections.title: Sapphire
collections.description:
SAPPHIRE COLLECTION

Thickness: 5mm      Wear Layer: 20 mil      Width: 9"        Length: 72"

The Sapphire collection scales up GemCore’s superior construction technology into a premium range of wide plank, long length stone composite floors with ultra-realistic wood looks. Offered in colors inspired by the most sought-after luxury hardwood collections from our sister company, Monarch Plank, the Sapphire Collection’s elegant 6’ long, 9” wide planks offer unrivaled quality in both appearance and function. All floors feature Embossed In Register (EIR) texture that perfectly follows the wood grain for maximum realism. The greater overall plank size is supported by a robust, commercially rated wear layer and our high-density premium XPE pre-attached pad.  GemCore boasts an array of advantages over other types of flooring, including superior stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance. Learn more about GemCore

collections.title: Sylvania
collections.description:
SYLVANIA COLLECTION

Thickness: 9/16"        Top Layer: 3mm      Width: 7"        Length: Random Length 17" - 84" (25% full)

The Sylvania Collection offers Character White Oak and Walnut with a sawn, resandable surface in an array of colors that blends both modern European and classic American aesthetics. Each Sylvania board is hand-stained by an experienced craftsmen to achieve a more rich, subtly layered color than standard machine staining. Featuring precision milling and a silky, ultra-matte urethane finish from Germany.

collections.title: Terreno
collections.description:
TERRENO COLLECTION

Thickness: 5/8"        Top Layer: 4mm       Width: 9-1/2"        Length: Random Length 23" - 86" (70% full)

Introducing Terreno, the companion to our beloved Urbano collection. Terreno showcases the charm of European Oak in a rustic grade, boasting impressively wide 9-1/2” planks, a robust 4mm sawn wear layer, and consistently long boards. Its subtly wire-brushed texture delicately highlights the innate grain patterns of Oak, while a captivating neutral color palette graces each plank. In every aspect, Terreno perfectly embodies Reward Flooring's commitment to delivering the harmonious blend of luxury and affordability, where you can indulge in the luxury of beautiful hardwood floors without compromising on value.

collections.title: Topaz
collections.description:
TOPAZ COLLECTION

Thickness: 5mm      Wear Layer: 20 mil      Width: 7"        Length: 48"

The Topaz collection is built with GemCore's industry leading stone composite technology. GemCore boasts an array of advantages over other types of flooring, including superior stability, dent & heat resistance, and 100% waterproof performance. The Topaz Collection offers a robust, commercially rated wear layer and our high-density XPE pre-attached pad. Offered in a classic 7" width, with a subtle "kissed" bevel and a wide range of wood looks, Topaz is a versatile option for residential and commercial floors where both beauty and durability are required. Learn more about GemCore

collections.title: Urbano
collections.description:
URBANO COLLECTION

Thickness: 5/8"        Top Layer: 4mm       Width: 9-1/2"        Length: Random Length 23" - 86" (50% full)

Meet Urbano, the sister to our gorgeous Terreno collection. Urbano brings you the timeless elegance of wide-plank 9-1/2” European Oak flooring in a Light Rustic grade, boasting fewer and smaller knots compared to most others in its class. Enhanced by a generous 4mm thick sawn wear layer, a palette of gentle, neutral hues, and a luxurious smooth finish, Urbano epitomizes accessible luxury. Its understated character provides just enough reminder that it's crafted entirely from 100% natural wood, without the more busy look of a fully rustic grade material.

collections.title: Yukon Gold
collections.description:
YUKON GOLD COLLECTION

Thickness: 1/2"        Top Layer: 2mm      Width: 6-1/2"        Length: Random Length 16" - 71" (12.5% full)

An update to our original Grand Yukon collection. Inspired by the rugged grandeur of our 49th state, Grand Yukon is the most dramatically scraped and distressed Reward Hardwood flooring option. Hand-applied artisan techniques result in a natural and random appeal unmatched by machine-created competitors. Planks are 6.5" wide with lengths up to 6' in Hickory and Betula.
